name: wp-referrer-canonical-source-name
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Search-referrer classification writes CANONICAL source names ('google', 'bing'), not the referrer host. Engine writes the full referrer host ('google.com').
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (rulings #4/#5): referrer classification writes CANONICAL source names ('google','bing',...) never raw hosts, via explicit domain-suffix rules incl. intl TLDs. Original note: engine wrote the full referrer host ('google.com').
